annotations.title: Email a code to a mailbox's address

description: Email a code to the mailbox's address. Sending it back with confirm_mailbox_address proves that the workspace can read mail there; a working login never proves that. Nothing sends from a mailbox until its address is confirmed (`ownership` on the mailbox). The code works for 30 minutes, and a new one stops the one before. At most 5 codes go to one address and 20 per workspace a UTC day (429, `details.scope` address or workspace). An address already confirmed answers 409; a server with no email set up answers 503, and staff can confirm the address instead. To read the code yourself, call list_threads with this mailboxId, once with `folder: inbox` and once with `folder: spam`, and use only the newest email from no-reply@colding.app that arrived after this request: the code is in its subject. A send-only mailbox can't be read here, so ask the person who reads that address, or call create_handoff with kind confirm_mailbox_address. It needs setup permission. A signed-in owner has it and can give it to an API key for the whole workspace. That key loses it if its maker stops being the owner.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.
